description:
Rs 99 Street Food Delhi  This Place Sells BEST Ambersari Chur Chur Naan White Butter | Chole Bhature

This place is hands down representing Delhi's Nashta which is their special 35 years old Amritsari Chur Chur Naan, Chole Bhature with their variety of Lassi. The place is called Sanjay Chur Chur Naan in Dwarka Sector 10. The place is known for their Thali starting from Rs. 99. They are totally inspired by Amritsari Culture. They begun at Moolchand in 1990 and people loved their food. The Nashta they present is fresh and buttery. I was drooling while shooting for this place. They have 14 types of Variety of stuffing. The laccha was crispy and flakky. I liked how people were gathered and enjoyed their meals. The place is best enjoyed when having food their at the restaurant. I took permission to record and showcase Delhi's authentic Nashta. Delhi breakfast comes in many forms but Chole Bhature and chur chur naan stands out everytime. You may either choose white butter or yellow butter on top of your parantha. Check out my reaction to this lovely place.
